steps.claim: Let π be the representation of G_f on forms on the standard space of rank |n| (weight of O) by right translation, composed with keeping only the components at the places of O (componentOn).

steps.claim: For k supported at the places of O, π(k) is the translation by k.
steps.lean:
have hπ {k} (h : k ∈ Gf.supportedOn n O.places) : π k = formTranslation _ _ k :=
    congrArg (formTranslation ..) (Gf.ext (by simp_all))

steps.claim: Let ρ be the action of the idempotent e_c = tupleIdem r c through the representation chosenGLRep of ∏ GL_r(k_w) on the level space of π.
For each u, record the formula for ρ(u):
(ρ u) is the sum over the group of the coefficients of e_c times the translations (unfolding chosenGLRep and levelRep).
